countingRule: Each item is one existing fighterId:moveKey production move row with a real native runtime behavior change. Tests, labels and references are supporting evidence, not additional delivered work items.
regressionFixes: End-of-round cleanup clears only the exact cage-owned temporary lift on native lethal grip or timeout; unrelated airborne KOs retain their own height.
A later physical hit cannot mark an already suspended victim grounded above the floor; escape, refresh and expiry release the lift through one posture cleanup.
Fixed bodies preserve directional attack commands while their locomotion and walk meter stay disabled.
The cinematic workstream requested one shared outro-staging condition for its two exact authored non-flyer outros; the flag does not affect combat moves.
